applied.problem: "Moving points that sit on the x-axis in a stretch" is false for a sideways stretch: f(½x) moves an x-axis crossing such as (4, 0) to (8, 0); only the up-and-down stretch leaves them put.
A real transformer given steady DC does give a brief pulse out at switch-on before falling to zero, so "gives nothing out" overstates it; "no lasting output" is what a specialist would say.
